priorityList: Maintain Windfury Weapon, Flametongue Weapon, and Lightning Shield buffs.
Cast Voltaic Blaze or Flame Shock if the Flame Shock DoT is not active on the target.
Cast Surging Totem on cooldown and ensure it remains active.
Cast Sundering if the Whirling Earth buff is active or to trigger Surging Elements.
Cast Lava Lash if the Whirling Fire or Hot Hand buffs are active.
Cast Primordial Storm at 10 stacks of Maelstrom Weapon (or at 5+ stacks if the buff is expiring).
Cast Windstrike while Ascendance is active.
Cast Crash Lightning or Stormstrike while Doom Winds or Ascendance is active to trigger Thorim's Invocation.
Cast Lightning Bolt if you have 10 stacks of Maelstrom Weapon.
Cast Crash Lightning if its buff is not active.
Cast Lava Lash as your primary filler.
Cast Stormstrike as your secondary filler.
Cast Lightning Bolt if you have 5 or more stacks of Maelstrom Weapon.
